brief:
British authorities denied entry to Swedish climate academic Andreas Malm on Friday, blocking him from an appearance scheduled alongside a co-founder of Palestine Action, designated a banned terrorist organization, according to Al-Monitor.

Malm announced the denial on social media, stating he had been barred from traveling to Britain for the speaking engagement. The group Palestine Action has faced proscription under British terrorism laws.
dek: By Yoruk Bahceli LONDON, Oct 30 (Reuters) - Swedish climate academic Andreas Malm said on Friday he had been denied entry to Britain, where he was due to speak alongside the co-founder of Palestine Action, a group banned as a terrorist organisation.
title: Britain denies entry to Swedish academic over Palestine Action appearance
